purpose: Benchmark-native data provenance for policy evaluation, reference reproduction, split validation, and train/evaluation leakage checks. This is not a general training-data catalog.

split_policy.train_id: Benchmark-released demonstrations permitted for training a reference policy; recorded only as policy provenance.
split_policy.eval_id: Unseen seeds or episodes from the same task distribution.
split_policy.eval_ood: Held-out objects, layouts, scenes, language, dynamics, or task compositions.

benchmark_native.evaluation_role: Validate RoboCasa365 split membership, reproduce released policies, and detect episode leakage.
Reproduce RoboTwin policies and freeze canonical task and episode manifests.
Reproduce the DOMINO reference policy and validate dynamic-manipulation splits.

benchmark_native.scale: 32 core datasets of 1000 episodes; 90-task VLA extension
benchmark_native.evaluation_role: Validate memory-intensive task splits and reproduce a released benchmark baseline.
Preserve the benchmark memory protocol and reproduce its specialist reference.
Record MolmoBot policy provenance and reproduce MolmoSpaces results without split collisions.
Validate EBench train, validation, and held-out evaluation boundaries.
Support reproducible long-horizon policy evaluation if the benchmark is integrated.
